'''The Oak and Thorn''' is an [[inn]] in [[Amador]]. As it is only referenced in passing, nothing is known about the location or appearance of the building.

The Oak and Thorn is where [[Morgase Trakand]] instructs [[Martyn Tallanvor]] to wait while she tries to flee the [[Children of the Light]].{{ref/book|6|31}}
